STIPULATION FOR ENTRY OF JUDGMENT, SIGNED BY ALL PARTIES,

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT WALDECK, HELMA (JUDGMENT IS NEITHER FOR NOR AGAINST PLTF. OR DEFT. (THE SYSTEM DOES NOT ALLOW SELECTION OF ALTERNATE CHOICES) JUDGMENT PURSUANT TO STIPULATION, TERMS AS FOLLOW: DEFT. SHALL RETAIN POSSESSION OF PREMISES COMMONLY KNOW AS AND LOCATED AT 40 ANZA VISTA, APT. #2, SAN FRANCISCO, CA, PURSUANT TO THE TERMS OF HER CURRENT MONTH-TO-MONTH RENTAL AGREEMENT EXCEPT AS MODIFIED BY THE FOLLOWING ADDITIONAL TERMS: A. DEFT'S RENT WILL BE $650.00 PER MONTH BEGINNING JANUARY, 1995 THROUGH DECEMBER, 1997, AND PLTFS. WAIVE ANY RIGHTS TO BANK ANY INCREASES ACCRUED DURING SUCH PERIOD. B. AS OF JANUARY, 1998, SUBSEQUENT RENTAL INCREASES TO DEFT. WILL BE SET PURSUANT TO THE THEN CURRENT PROVISIONS OF THE SAN FRANCISCO ADMINISTRATIVE CODE, CHAPTER 37, WITH A BASE RENT OF $650.00 AND AN ANNIVERSARY DATE OF JANUARY 1, 1997. HOWEVER, NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, PLTFS. WILL BE ALLOWED TO PASS ALONG ANY COSTS OF CAPTIAL IMPROVEMENTS INCURRED AFTER JANUARY 1, 1994, AS PERMITTED BY LOCAL AND STATE LAW. (SEE FILE FOR FURTHER DETAILS RE: SETTLEMENT TERMS)
